name: Summon Felsteed
label: Quest
description: Summon Felsteed: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hmph. I say you're not prepared, but that is not my decision. Strahad feels otherwise, and it is his decision to make... This time.
He wishes to speak to you, and quickly. You'll find him still above Ratchet in the Barrens, at his little tower there with his acolytes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you've decided to grace my presence again. How kind of you.
My acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.
